title: OutgoingTestRequest
description: Outgoing test request submitted by the Python Intelligence Layer to the Rust Security Kernel. The Rust kernel independently validates scope, rate limits, and budgets before executing.

credential_ref.description: Symbolic credential alias to be resolved by the Rust Credential Broker

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this test request probe

target_url.description: Destination target URL (must resolve to authorized domain allowlist)

tenant_context.description: Optional tenant context (persona) simulating the request

test_id.description: Parent test suite or finding hypothesis ID

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds (capped by authoritative test budgets)

InvariantId.description: Canonical B2B Travel Security Invariant Identifiers.

oneOf.description: I-01: Multi-tenant data and state isolation (BOLA / IDOR)
I-02: Tariff and price integrity across hold-to-confirm transitions
I-03: Inventory hold lifecycle and cancellation concurrency
I-04: Deprecated or shadow API boundary enforcement

TenantContext.description: Contextual identity of an authenticated participant in a travel transaction. Notice: Raw bearer tokens and credentials are excluded by design to prevent leaks.

oneOf.description: Standard travel agent with search, quote, hold, and book rights
Sub-agent with restricted search and hold rights
